tbesh_html:
§ Arnon = "rushing stream"
a river and surrounding valley in south Palestine, forms the border between Moab and the Amorites

strongs_1890.strongs_def: the Arnon, a river east of the Jordan, also its territory
strongs_1890.derivation: or אַרְנֹןlemma אַרְנן missing vowel, corrected to אַרְנֹן; from H7442 (רָנַן); a brawling stream;
